{"metadata":{"description":"MySQL connector plugin for DeepSeek Harness: configure connections in settings, switch per session from the composer, and expose mysql_query/mysql_tables/mysql_execute tools to every agent preset.","id":"gh:1337916824","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-mysql","slug":"1321928757/dsh-mysql","topics":["connector","database","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","mysql","sql","tools"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"MySQL connector plugin for DeepSeek Harness: configure connections in settings, switch per session f"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"rom the composer, and expose mysql_query/mysql_tables/mysql_execute tools to every agent preset."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-mysql"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"MySQL connections and guarded database tools for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Configure connections once, choose one or more per conversation, and let your agent route each call "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"to a selected data source."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"`dsh-mysql` is a profile bundle for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). It adds a settings page for multiple MyS"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"QL connections, a per-session connection picker beside the composer, and four guarded tools that eve"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ry agent preset can use. No preset edits are required."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> **Data boundary:** connection settings and passwords stay in your local DSH storage. Database sche"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ma and query results are sent to the LLM provider as ordinary tool output when the agent uses a data"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ry results are sent to the LLM provider as ordinary tool output when the agent uses a database tool."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **Multiple connections:** keep separate development, staging, or production data sources in one DS"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"H installation.
- **Per-session multi-selection:** each conversation independently selects zero, one"},{"id":"p9s3","text":", or multiple sources. Select/deselect takes effect immediately; clearing the last selection leaves "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"the session without database access until a source is selected again. A session with multiple config"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"ured sources starts empty; a sole configured source is auto-selected on first initialization. Select"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"ion is runtime-only and is not restored after a DSH restart.
- **One target per tool call:** when mu"},{"id":"p9s7","text":"ltiple sources are selected, the agent passes one selected `connectionId` to each tool call. A singl"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"e selected source may be inferred. Queries are never broadcast or merged across sources.
- **Schema-"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"first workflow:** `mysql_tables` exposes readable columns, types, nullability, keys, and comments be"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"fore a query is written.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Requirements and compatibility"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- A DSH installation with the **Web profile** and Node.js **20 or newer**.
- **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 or new"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"er, below 0.3.0.** Version 0.2.0 of this plugin migrates its Typert RPC manifest to the DSH 0.2 stri"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ct codec contract (`create()` factory) and no longer loads on DSH 0.1.x — use plugin 0.1.11 there.
-"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" A MySQL-compatible server reachable through the configured TCP host and port.
- The connection form"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" currently supports host, port, username, password, default database, table allowlist, and write per"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"mission. It does not expose SSL/TLS, Unix socket/named-pipe, or charset options.
- The `MAX_EXECUTIO"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"N_TIME` optimizer hint is intended for MySQL versions that support it (MySQL 5.7.8+). MariaDB may ha"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"ndle this hint differently; `SHOW`, `DESCRIBE`, and `EXPLAIN` do not receive the hint.
- `mysql_tabl"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"es` discovers tables in `DATABASE()`. Configure a default database if you want schema discovery; a c"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"onnection without one can return an empty table list."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Security and permissions"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The plugin uses multiple guardrails, but it does not replace database permissions. Use a dedicated M"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ySQL account with the least privileges possible; for read-only work, a `SELECT`-only account is reco"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"ount with the least privileges possible; for read-only work, a `SELECT`-only account is recommended."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Guardrail | What is enforced | Important boundary |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Statement type | `mysql_query` accepts read statements; `mysql_execute` accepts only `INSERT`/`UPD"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ATE`/`DELETE`; `mysql_ddl` accepts the supported table/view/index schema changes. | The tool layer i"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"s not a general SQL console. |
| Row-write permission | `mysql_execute` requires the selected connec"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"tion's `allowWrite` flag. | Per connection, default off, with a separate risk acknowledgement. |
| S"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"chema-change permission | `mysql_ddl` requires the independent `allowDdl` flag; changed/deleted targ"},{"id":"p15s6","text":"ets obey the allowlist, and explicit database qualifiers must match the default database. | Default "},{"id":"p15s7","text":"off with a separate acknowledgement; account/privilege and database-level statements stay refused. |"},{"id":"p15s8","text":"
| Multi-statement SQL | Multiple statements and transaction/control statements are rejected. | Sche"},{"id":"p15s9","text":"ma changes are issued one statement per call. |
| Table allowlist | Checks table references detected"},{"id":"p15s10","text":" after `FROM`, `JOIN`, `UPDATE`, and `INTO`. An empty list means no configured table restriction. | "},{"id":"p15s11","text":"This is a lexical check, not a full SQL parser. Forms such as `DESCRIBE t` or `SHOW CREATE TABLE t` "},{"id":"p15s12","text":"do not use those reference keywords; combine the allowlist with database-level grants. |
| Result si"},{"id":"p15s13","text":"ze | The serialized tool response contains at most 2,000 rows and reports `truncated: true` when row"},{"id":"p15s14","text":"s were omitted. | The query is fetched before the response is truncated; this is not a server-side s"},{"id":"p15s15","text":"can or network limit. |
| Credential exposure | Passwords are stored in local `connections.json`; th"},{"id":"p15s16","text":"e browser receives only `hasPassword`. | Query results, schema, and tool arguments are still sent to"},{"id":"p15s17","text":" the configured LLM provider. |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Passwords are stored as plain text in `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-mysql/connections.json`. Protect this "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"file with operating-system permissions and do not commit or share it."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- Each conversation session independently selects zero, one, or multiple database sources; changes d"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"o not affect other sessions. An empty selection disables database tools for that session. Selection "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"state is kept in memory and reinitialized after a DSH restart.
- Each tool call targets exactly one "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"source; when multiple sources are selected, `connectionId` is required. The plugin does not broadcas"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"t queries or merge results across databases.
- `mysql_tables` uses the connection's `DATABASE()` val"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ue, so schema discovery may be empty when no default database is configured. It does not browse arbi"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"trary databases.
- The table allowlist is intentionally lightweight and checks common table-referenc"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"e positions rather than parsing every MySQL grammar form.
- The 2,000-row limit applies to the retur"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"ned JSON payload after the database response has been fetched.
- `mysql_execute` remains limited to "},{"id":"p18s10","text":"row writes; it does not provide transaction management or a confirmation workflow. `mysql_ddl` has n"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"o per-call approval; it is guarded by a per-connection opt-in, allowlist, and default-database bound"},{"id":"p18s12","text":"ary. Use a narrowly scoped database account.
- Connection configuration is TCP-oriented and has no U"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"I for SSL/TLS, Unix sockets/named pipes, or character-set selection."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
